name: doc-roadmap-review-pre-read
description: Writes a Roadmap Review Pre-Read with the decision asked at the top, what changed since last time and why, Now, Next and Later with confidence, and what is not on the roadmap and why. Use for "run doc-roadmap-review-pre-read", "pre-read for the roadmap review", "roadmap review memo", "we keep explaining instead of deciding", "what changed on the roadmap", "now next later with confidence", "prep the quarterly roadmap meeting", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
